name: Lemon-Dill Tuna Toasts with Bell Pepper, Artichoke & Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons. Divide between one medium and one large bowl, then set the large bowl aside for later use.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the remaining medium bowl with the lemon.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts; drain olives. Add both to the bowl, along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the veggie salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
1 ½ (3.8 oz) cans sliced black olives
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the reserved large bowl with the lemon.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp oregano, dried
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)

Divide bread between two large baking sheet pans, then drizzle with oil. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices sourdough bread
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Spread the tuna salad over each toast, then top with a small portion of the veggie salad.
Divide toast between plates and serve with remaining salad on the side. Enjoy!
